ns2:course.label: Model Organisms & Epigenetics
ns2:course.description: Explores the main eukaryotic model genetic organisms/systems used in molecular and biomedical research including plants, animals, insects, fungi, and cell culture. The framework for lectures and discussions focuses on epigenetic mechanisms of gene regulation and genome organization. Includes reading, discussion, the presentation of the primary research literature with emphasis on experimental methods and design. This course may not be repeated for credit. Prerequisite: MCB 250-MCB 253 and MCB 354, or graduate standing, or consent of instructor.
